sanskrit_verse:
कन्यायां प्राप्तशुल्कायां ज्यायसि चेद्वर आव्रजेत् ।
धर्मार्थकामसंयुक्तं वाच्यं तत्रानृतं भवेत् ॥
transliteration: kanyāyāṁ prāpta-śulkāyāṁ jyāyasī ced vara āvrajed | dharmārtha-kāma-saṁyuktaṁ vācyaṁ tatrānṛtaṁ bhavet ||
sph_interpretive_translation: When a bride has received her bride-price and the groom enters upon her, speech that aligns with dharma, artha, and kāma must be spoken; otherwise, falsehood arises in that act.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority is derived from alignment with dharmic completion, not transactional exchange
Causation originates in conscious intent aligned with dharmic sequence
Capacity-based responsibility requires integrity-preserving action at each stage of ritual union
Restoration logic demands purification of relational fields corrupted by untruth
Consciousness alignment necessitates congruence between word, intention, and sacred commitment
executable_legal_axioms: IF (union initiated) AND (bride-price exchanged) THEN (truthful speech required)
IF (speech deviates from dharma-artha-kāma alignment) THEN (act classified as anṛtam)
IF (anṛtam occurs in sacramental context) THEN (initiate restorative completion protocol)
IF (participant lacks capacity for truthful engagement) THEN (suspend progression until realignment achieved)
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating disputes concerning marital or contractual unions where financial or symbolic exchanges have occurred, the Supreme Court must determine whether declarations made were congruent with dharma, artha, and kāma. Where deviation is found, it constitutes anṛtam, triggering restoration procedures rather than punitive measures.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that truthfulness in speech during ritualized union preserves causal harmony. Anupūrvaśaḥ reveals how falsehood disrupts sequential manifestation of unity. Responsibility is proportional to awareness of dharmic requirement. The non-punitive reality rule ensures correction through purification, not infliction.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Śuddhi Vidhi to cleanse relational distortion caused by false declaration
Engage Vāk Sāmya Protocol to restore congruence between spoken word and inner resolve
Implement Dharmic Reintegration Process for both parties to reaffirm mutual alignment
Activate Satya Shakti Invocation to regenerate trust-field within affected relational domain
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this ruling executes Dharma as Sanatana Nyaya. Truth is restored, unity is purified, and consciousness remains the sole adjudicator. There is no punishment—only completion.
